title: Cambridge IELTS 17 Test 2 Writing Task 1
directions:
You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.
Write at least 150 words.
prompt:
The table and charts below give information on the police budget for 2017 and 2018 in one area of Britain. The table shows where the money came from and the charts show how it was distributed.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
scenario: The table and charts below give information on the police budget for 2017 and 2018 in one area of Britain. The table shows where the money came from and the charts show how it was distributed.
requirements: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

visualData.title: Police Budget 2017–2018 (in £m)
visualData.units: £m for the table; percentages for the pie charts
notes: 2017 spending: Salaries (officers and staff) 75%; Technology 8%; Buildings and transport 17%.
2018 spending: Salaries (officers and staff) 69%; Technology 14%; Buildings and transport 17%.
